runtimeconditions.binding-manifest.schem.title: Runtime Conditions structural binding manifest
runtimeconditions.binding-manifest.schem.description: Native binding symbols and their structural relationships to one normalized binding model. Consumers must recompute the model digest, compare the root extension identity and digest with the resolved extension, compare package identity with native package-manager resolution, and verify every modelRef and native type edge. v1alpha1 symbol inventories are invalid here.

package.description: For Go, coordinate is the package import path, name is the Go package name, and version is the resolved module version. For Python, coordinate is the distribution name, name is the import package, and version is the installed distribution version. Consumers must compare all applicable fields to native package-manager metadata.

extensionIdentifier.description: IDs SHOULD use a resolver-supported format; URI syntax is not required.

modelRef.description: The coordinate and optional JSON Pointer are separate normalized-model fields. Consumers must locate exactly one referenced node in the model; a string concatenation of these values is not a substitute for that lookup.

reference.description: Exactly one local native type or language builtin. Pointer records Go pointer syntax; nullable records a Python annotation accepting None. A consumer must resolve every type to exactly one entry in types.

rootBinding.description: Connects a declaration call to a value at an exact scope and serialized path. The modelRef identifies the vocabulary or schema node represented by this binding. schemaCoordinate and vocabularyCoordinate disambiguate Python schema-specific wrappers and vocabulary identities when present.

field.description: A child of its containing named type. sourceName is the serialized property name; synthetic marks a Python wrapper's native value field, whose sourceName is inherited from the wrapped property.

element.description: The array item or map value of its containing named type. Its modelRef identifies the child shape, including an exact JSON Pointer when present.

variant.description: One union alternative in normalized model order. Its value identifies the exact native representation of that alternative.

member.description: A string-domain value on its containing scalar type. The literal value disambiguates members sharing a domain or shape modelRef.

namedType.description: A local native symbol. Its fields, element, variants, and members belong to this symbol; no separate parent string is needed. wrapper represents a Python declaration field object around a non-object model shape. Anonymous child shapes inherit their parent's serialized sourceName; modelRef and the containing edge identify the precise child.

extensionIdentifier.description: IDs SHOULD use a resolver-supported format; URI syntax is not required.

runtimeconditions.binding-release.schema.title: Runtime Conditions binding release manifest
runtimeconditions.binding-release.schema.description: Shared release-provenance contract for Go and Python binding packages. A test-fixture manifest identifies actual Phase 4 assembly; a production manifest identifies the Phase 5 orchestrator and committed release target. Consumers must also compare package identity with native package metadata, recompute model and extension digests, and compare every dependency-lock entry with the resolved model closure and source bytes. JSON Schema alone cannot establish those cross-document or artifact-content equalities.

packageDependencies.description: Exact tested direct language-package dependencies. The native package metadata must declare the same dependencies and compatible intervals; transitive packages supply their own release manifests. Consumers must reject duplicate extension or package coordinates.

extensionIdentifier.description: IDs SHOULD use a resolver-supported format; URI syntax is not required.

package.description: Matches the emitter target and runtimeconditions.bindings.yaml package. Go coordinate is the package import path, name is the Go package name, and version is the resolved module version. Python coordinate is the distribution name, name is the import package, and version is the installed distribution version. Publication mode describes the intended target and does not imply a test fixture was published.

dependencyLock.description: Exact resolver output, separate from the normalized model and its digest. Consumers must require exactly one entry per extension in the model, including the root, and compare identifiers, versions, semantic digests, and direct dependency edges with that model.

compatibleVersionRange.description: The tested lower bound is inclusive and the next breaking version is exclusive. Consumers must derive the language-native requirement and verify that testedVersion lies in this interval.

artifact.description: SHA-256 of the exact installed dependency archive used for testing. This is a dependency artifact, not a digest of the current package archive, which would make the embedded manifest self-referential.

fixtureProvenance.description: Phase 4 test-package assembly. These packages exercise the final installed resource location but are never promotion or publication evidence.

productionProvenance.description: Phase 5 and later committed package assembly. Source directory and tag must match the package key, language, and declared version; consumers must enforce these cross-field equalities.

id.description: IDs SHOULD use a resolver-supported format; URI syntax is not required.
